# NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB

NVIDIA released this text model on October 23. It post-trains Gemma 4 E4B for local assistants and tool use. L [model-card].

## How to instruct it

### Setting up the prompt

NVIDIA's guide puts role, rules and formatting constraints in the system message, and states an explicit objective and completion condition. Context uses genuine system, user, assistant and tool turns in the supported chat template. Environment observations are supplied explicitly. L [model-card].

### Reasoning and effort

`enable_thinking=True/False` controls thinking in the chat template; the serving runtime can also set its thinking budget. These are template/runtime controls, not a verified universal API effort enum. L [model-card].

### Output: format, length, tone

`conversational_mode` is a separate template control. L [model-card].

### Tools and agents

The guide declares tools through the native `tools` interface with names, descriptions and argument schemas. Assistant calls use `message.tool_calls`; tool results keep the matching call ids and immediately follow the assistant message that called them. For asynchronous work, NVIDIA describes an immediate pending acknowledgement in the tool response, followed later by the completed result in a user message. The training claim does not establish independent tool reliability. L [model-card].

### Coding

No independent coding-agent result was verified.

### Long context and retrieval

The card lists 64K input and output limits. L [model-card].

### Structured output

The maker reports structured-output training and tests; endpoint schema guarantees were not verified. L [model-card].

### Images, audio, other inputs

Text only. Its local voice-assistant use case does not establish audio input or output. L [model-card].

### Sampling and API parameters

The summary recommends temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95; these are recommendations, not fixed API constraints. L [model-card].

### Migrating from the previous generation

No migration comparison was verified.
